# BonniePdfLicense

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The application's BonniePDF licence declaration.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`Tier`](#tier): Which BonniePDF licence applies to this application.

### `Tier`

```csharp
static LicenseTier? Tier { get; set; }
```

*static*

Which BonniePDF licence applies to this application.

Set once at startup, before generating the first document:

```csharp
BonniePdfLicense.Tier = LicenseTier.Community;
```

There is no licence key, no activation, and no telemetry — this is a self-declaration. `BONNIEPDF_LICENSE` in the environment is an equivalent way to state it where a startup hook is awkward; this property takes precedence over it.

Assigning a value outside `LicenseTier` throws `InvalidLicenseTierException` immediately: that is a bad cast in your startup code, not a licensing state.

Assignment after the first document has been generated is allowed but has no retroactive effect — the one-time notice has already been decided.
